name: Bounded Prompt and Demonstration Search
mechanism: Searches a declared prompt and demonstration surface under a fixed task metric, rollout budget, baseline and protected selection split.
use_when: Behavior can improve without changing model weights or runtime authority
A representative development and selection set exists
avoid_when: The target failure is caused by missing tools data or deterministic logic
Prompt changes can silently expand permissions or mutable policy
expected_effects: Candidate improvements measured under equal budget
failure_modes: Prompt grows in cost or brittleness
Gain fails to transfer across model versions
